description: This file defines the class VTCreateEntityTask which extends VTTask and implements a task that creates a new entity record in VTiger CRM based on provided data and mappings.

classes.name: VTCreateEntityTask
classes.description: A task class used in workflow automation to create a new CRM entity based on specified field mappings and current entity data.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of field names relevant to the task: 'entity_type', 'reference_field', 'field_value_mapping'.

methods.name: doTask
methods.description: Performs the task of creating a new entity in CRM, populating its fields according to the specified mappings, and linking it to the current entity.
